text_block_list.text:
While taking a walk around the academy for 
a change of pace...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
When vibes are low, crank 'em up double!! 
Drop those ear-blasting vibes—!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ah! If it isn't Trai-pi! Good work today~☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Man, my head's been pounding like crazy 
since this morning~. Hahaha~, totally for 
real!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
That said, being all depressed and sinking 
into despair is a total downer, right? 
Which means we gotta hype it up, right?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Which means a live concert, right! So I 
was getting totally hyped up on those 
blasting vibes~.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
...If anything, it turned out even more 
pungent☆ Bwahahaha~~!

After that, Daitaku Helios ended up 
suffering from a headache for a while.
